$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['name', 'key', 'joinedAt']) && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length >= 1 && newData.child('name').val().length <= 20 && newData.child('key').isString() && root.child('quiz/names/' + newData.child('key').val()).val() == auth.uid

$uid..write: auth != null && auth.uid == $uid && !data.exists() && root.child('quiz/state/phase').val() == 'question' && root.child('quiz/state/qKey').val() == $q && root.child('quiz/players/' + $uid).exists()
$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['choice', 'at']) && newData.child('choice').isNumber() && newData.child('choice').val() >= 0 && newData.child('choice').val() <= 3 && newData.child('at').val() == now
